Loopback to spec-writer: S1/S3/S4/S5 evidence missing: no executed run exists. There is no committed RESULTS.md at the repo root. The only RESULTS.md is runs/wo-gh-1/evidence/preflight-run/RESULTS.md, which records a failed preflight against the OLD chat pin (HTTP 410). Spec 'Done' requires an end-to-end GitHub Actions run, with RESULTS.md and run artifacts committed. The builder output itself says this has not happened.; Harness code appears to map to the scenarios (src/auto_ontology_eval: smoke, fixture, reconcile, ablation, results, equivalents, secrets; fixture/ has checklist.json, questions.json, GROUND_TRUTH.md, source_a, source_b; .github/workflows/auto-ontology-eval.yml). I could not confirm it works against the live stack. I did not run the tests, because pytest is not installed in this environment. I am relying on the builder's claim of 97 passing tests with 1 skipped.; Spec Amendment 1 (chat model nvidia/nemotron-nano-3-30b-a3b) is applied consistently in config.CHAT_MODEL. The work order text still quotes the old pin; the amendment explicitly governs, so this is acceptable. The spec header still says 'Status: draft' although the work order calls it approved. The spec owner should fix that.; The preflight failed closed as required, with no model substitution and no estimates. That evidence predates Amendment 1, since it names the old pin. I found no evidence that the new pin nvidia/nemotron-nano-3-30b-a3b is served by the hosted endpoint. runs/wo-gh-1/capture_failure.txt only says 'no servable configuration found', and I could not determine what it refers to. Servability of the new pin is unverified.; S5 limits: the two known equivalents (MCP tools listed in process, raw-schema SQL run on a SQLite copy) are recorded in equivalents.json and rendered in the Limits section, as required. Whether the live steps actually write these entries is unverified until a live run happens.; Not a pass: the implementation is spec-conformant as far as static reading goes, but the spec's acceptance evidence (executed S1-S5 results) does not exist. Rerun in GitHub Actions with a servable chat model and the NVIDIA_API_KEY secret, then resubmit.
